channels.label: ROC_LOC
channels.reason: Bipolar right-left EOG derivation with a neuro trace, kept as the single EOG channel.

channels.label: LOC_ROC
channels.reason: Inverse duplicate of the ROC-LOC derivation, and EOG is already taken.

channels.label: F2_F4
channels.reason: Bipolar frontal chain with no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: F4_C4
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain with no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: C4_P4
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain with no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: P4_O2
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain with no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: C4_A1
channels.reason: C4 referenced to the contralateral left ear A1, equivalent to C4-M1, with a neuro trace.

channels.label: EMG1_EMG2
channels.reason: Bipolar EMG (presumed chin) at 10-100 Hz with an EMG-like trace.

channels.label: ECG1_ECG2
channels.reason: Bipolar ECG derivation with an ECG trace.

channels.label: TERMISTORE
channels.reason: Italian 'termistore' (thermistor) is an airflow sensor and the trace is respiratory.

channels.label: TORACE
channels.reason: Italian 'torace' means thorax, but the trace looked neuro rather than respiratory, so it is left unmapped.

channels.label: ADDOME
channels.reason: Italian 'addome' is abdominal effort and the trace is respiratory.

channels.label: Dx1_DX2
channels.reason: Italian 'dx' (right) EMG pair with an EMG trace, taken as the right leg.

channels.label: SX1_SX2
channels.reason: Italian 'sx' (left) EMG pair with an EMG trace, taken as the left leg.

channels.label: Posizione
channels.reason: Italian 'posizione' is the body-position DC channel; a flat trace fits an unchanging position.

channels.label: HR
channels.reason: Oximeter heart rate in BPM with an HR trace.

channels.label: SpO2
channels.reason: Oximeter saturation in % with an SpO2 trace.

channels.label: Sound
channels.reason: Sound transducer channel used for snoring, with a high-frequency trace.
